description: Three bowls sit on the green bedspread in front of a large pillow: an orange bowl closest to you, with a dark gray bowl and a light lavender bowl behind it. The left hand slides in to hold the orange bowl steady while the right hand reaches to the dark gray bowl, lifts it, and nests it into the orange bowl; then the right hand picks up the light lavender bowl and places it on top, forming a neat stack as both hands release.
